Name: Easier Dart Puzzle
Author: Atravita
TagLine: Lets you adjust the difficult of the darts puzzle
Description:
This mod allows you to adjust the difficulty of the darts game.

Install

1.  Install the latest version of [SMAPI](https://smapi.io).

2.  Download and install [AtraCore](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12932).

3.  Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].

4.  Run the game using SMAPI.
Configuration
Run SMAPI at least once with this mod installed to generate the [font=Courier New]config.json[/font], or use [Generic Mod Config Menu](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098) to configure.

Options
* [font=Courier New]MPPirateArrivalTime[/font] - when the pirates show up and start partying, in multiplayer. This setting was put in because the darts game won't freeze time in multiplayer, which adds an element of time pressure.
* [font=Courier New]MinDartCount[/font] - the dart count for the hardest round of the game.
* [font=Courier New]MaxDartCount[/font] - the dart count for the easiest round of the game.
* [font=Courier New]ShowDartMarker[/font] - draws a small dot at the center of the circle.
* [font=Courier New]JitterMultiplier[/font] - how fast the dart should move in its figure-8 pattern. Set higher for slower dart movement.
* [font=Courier New]DartPrecision[/font] - how much randomness the dart should have after it's released. Set higher for less dart randomness.

(note - if you set the [font=Courier New]MinDartCount[/font] greater than the [font=Courier New]MaxDartCount[/font], the code will automatically swap the two.)

Compatibility

*   Works with Stardew Valley 1.5.6 on Linux/macOS/Windows.

*   Works in single player, multiplayer, and split-screen mode. Probably fine for only one player to install in multiplayer, but I haven't tested this. Safer for both to install.

*   Should be compatible with most other mods.
